video_title: Is Houston An NBA Finals Sleeper? No Kyrie Trade Coming? + 76ers’ Dream Start

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Houston Rockets' impressive 6-1 start to the season
quotes.excerpt: the Houston Rockets, who won to move to six and one on the season
quotes.quote: I want to start with the Houston Rockets, who won to move to six and one on the season. When we went to see them in Macau, they looked pretty impressive and they felt pretty good about themselves. They beat the Thunder, a game that at one time looked like it was a pretty big game. Obviously, the Thunder were without three starters. Nobody cried for the Rockets last year when they had a bunch of injuries.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis's intense focus during the 2022-23 preseason
quotes.excerpt: you could smell the fear on the whole organization he was going to walk
quotes.quote: I remember Anthony Davis's last year in New Orleans. I went down there to do an interview with him in the preseason. It was actually kind of melancholy because you could smell the fear on the whole organization he was going to walk. I got used to that from LeBron in Cleveland when he was going to walk. I remember that fear, everybody was afraid. Anthony Davis was in a good frame of mind at that point, intending to go full out the whole season. It was a Saturday night, there was an LSU game on at the same time and the building in New Orleans was empty. Anthony Davis was playing hard to the point where he jumped into the stands to save a loose ball going out of bounds in the preseason and there was nobody in 20 straight empty seats.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Toronto Raptors' impressive performance after trading for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: they had just traded for Kawhi and they looked spectacular
quotes.quote: The team they were playing that night was the Toronto Raptors and I was watching the Raptors. They had just traded for Kawhi and they looked spectacular. This guy who I had never seen play more than eight minutes and a half, Pascal Siakam, was out there crushing. Kawhi looked good, Fred VanVleet looked good. I remember watching this game and saying, 'Holy Moses, are the Raptors...' We knew they were going to be a contender, but my God, did they look good.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of the Kevin Durant trade on the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: they went out and got a Hall of Famer to fill that role
quotes.quote: When the Rockets made the Kevin Durant trade, I think the immediate reaction was, this is a team that desperately needed a two-guy. They went out and got a Hall of Famer to fill that role. They've got a chance to be contenders right now. And everything changed when they took the trip to the Bahamas and Fred VanVleet went down. And then things changed even more when Stephen Adams went down. Stephen Adams is dealing with stuff and look, the hope is he can give you 15 or 20 minutes in the playoffs, they'll manage him until then. Fred VanVleet being back just puts everything and everybody in the right spots.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Smith Jr.'s development and confidence this season
quotes.excerpt: Jabari Smith, who joined us at the start of the season on the pod, right now, everything looks great
quotes.quote: They are running hot right now. They have the number one offense in the league. We are a week and a half in. Jabari Smith, who joined us at the start of the season on the pod, right now, everything looks great for him because he is crushing his outside shot. He is shooting 45% from three. When you watch him, he is playing with a lot of confidence. I don't want to overreact to it. He is still a very young player, relatively. He is 23. I don't want to overreact to it, but he is playing with an incredible amount of offensive confidence right now.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's future with the Dallas Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: the more I see the team, the more I think it's going to be awfully hard to trade him
quotes.quote: Going into the season, I would have said more likely than not, he gets moved by the deadline, but I didn't feel super strong about it. The more I see the team, the more I think it's going to be awfully hard to trade him. Not that there won't be a big market, there will be, but if they've got a chance to compete for a play-in, playoff spot, I just think it's going to be really tough to move Kyrie. Also, as much as he means to that locker room as well as he's working with Luka, it was beautiful basketball.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Injury updates on Dereck Lively II and Santi Aldama
quotes.excerpt: Aldama's close, he's been down practicing with the Texas Legends, Lively, there's still no timeline
quotes.quote: Aldama's close, he's been down practicing with the Texas Legends, Lively, there's still no timeline and look, it's not a week-to-week thing, I'll tell you that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Dallas Mavericks' depth and roster challenges
quotes.excerpt: they got two bigs, Santi Aldama and Dereck Lively, who are out
quotes.quote: They got two bigs, Santi Aldama and Dereck Lively, who are out. Now I don't know what the prognosis is. Aldama is a starting four. Well, so is PJ Washington. But my point is that they got, I mean, that those are, you know, Lively I don't know what you can count on, but I mean, Lively is a real player if he's healthy.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's performance and the San Antonio Spurs' outlook
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama started a little sluggishly, he had 43 on Saturday night
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama started a little sluggishly, his stats were okay, but he started a little sluggishly. Yeah, he had 43 on Saturday night. I will point out that Rudy Gobert did not play in that game, but he played another Frenchman, Batum, who is an interesting prospect. I like Batum. Yeah, so do they. I think he's pretty much untouchable on that team.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's performance in the first quarter against the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Luka put up 21 and five assists in the first quarter
quotes.quote: I watched the first quarter, Luka put up 21 and five assists in the first quarter. Kyrie has averaged 21 and five. And we're just saying, boy, he looks great. That's what, that's what Luka had in the first quarter tonight. I sent you a text, I go, Luka might get 60 tonight.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bill Simmons's influence on NBA trade value analysis
quotes.excerpt: Bill Simmons, he sort of pioneered, at least as I remember, he did the trade value
quotes.quote: Bill Simmons, he sort of pioneered, at least as I remember, he did the trade value. He would write a column every year, maybe he did it more than once a year, where he would rank all top 100 or top 50 or whatever, most trade value. I think it would not be controversial to say that Luka is number one and Cooper is number two, if for no other reason than one of them is 19 and one of them is 22.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of injuries on the Dallas Mavericks' roster
quotes.excerpt: the Mavericks' cratering was tied to injuries
quotes.quote: Anthony Davis got hurt in the first game. They shouldn't have played him, but he got hurt in the first game. And then like what, the fifth game after that, Kyrie tore his ACL? It was a little longer than that, it was about a month after. The point is that the Mavericks' cratering was tied to injuries. Now that doesn't mean that the trade made any sense, but the reason the Mavericks cratered was because there were two unforeseen injuries, and severe injuries. And then they got lucky. What were they, the eighth, the ninth? I think they were ninth in odds and they got Cooper.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The chemistry between LeBron James and Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: the thing that made LeBron and Kyrie so terrific together is that LeBron could bring the ball up
quotes.quote: The thing that made LeBron and Kyrie so terrific together is that LeBron could bring the ball up and Kyrie could play on and off the ball. Now it was an issue at the start because Kyrie didn't want to pass the ball because what, you know, when Kyrie got, you know, Kyrie didn't think he was going to be playing with LeBron, you know, they, they signed, they hired David Blatt and David Blatt and Tyronn Lue went and met with Kyrie Irving on the night of June 30th and they laid out this whole plan about what players they were going to go try to recruit and they said, 'Kyrie, here's a five-year max contract, we're going to build the team around you.' And this is great. He thought they were going to try to sign Gordon Hayward. And they, he, he commits to the, to the full max and then 10, I don't know, 11 days later, LeBron and Kevin Love are there. So, you know, trust me, David Blatt was off, off, off balance, so was Kyrie. So was the un-waivers, by the way, who didn't make, didn't make it to Christmas.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's role as a clutch player
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie has always been a killer clutch player because he's so great in isolation
quotes.quote: Especially in fourth quarters, Kyrie has always been a killer clutch player because he's so great in isolation. And look, when it came time that the Cavs needing a basket against the Warriors, they went to Kyrie because Kyrie, they could isolate Kyrie on Curry and he'd go to work.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Memphis Grizzlies' performance and team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: I just want to shout out the Grizzlies who moved to six and zero
quotes.quote: I just want to shout out the Grizzlies who moved to six and zero. Now they're, they, they, since we last podded, they did, they won in Portland to go four and zero on that West Coast trip or five, three and zero or four and zero on that West Coast trip. Now they beat the Kings for the second time, which the Kings are zero and six and you wonder, um, I don't know. A-Cuff had 38 on Saturday. He took 25 shots, I think, and Domantas Sabonis took five.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Memphis Grizzlies' young foundation and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: they've got a really nice young foundation
quotes.quote: They've got a really nice young foundation. Ja Morant is, is got a lot of freedom and he, and he's putting up huge numbers. You know, they've got, uh, some toughness. They got, you know, like Beef Stew, there's a tone he sets coming off the bench. He's got a mean streak about him. And I was talking to an executive from another West team about the Grizzlies and I thought he put it pretty well. He said, 'They're, they've got a bunch of guys with something to prove that play well together.' Like all these young pieces fit, all their pieces fit. And I don't know what their ceiling is. I think their ceiling will be higher after the summer when they've got flexibility and they can be aggressive either via trade or like restricted free agency.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Philadelphia 76ers' clutch performance and roster challenges
quotes.excerpt: Philly is six and one, all six wins, clutch time wins
quotes.quote: Philly is six and one, all six wins, clutch time wins. And if you go under the hood and try to figure out why they're winning these close games, obviously they have really good players, but LeBron and Embiid did not play on Saturday. But they don't turn the ball over. They're first in fewest turnovers in the league, and they defend. They've routinely been, you know, and that's despite patchwork in their center position. You know, when you don't play LeBron and Embiid, you take out two of your top centers because LeBron is playing center.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of Nick Nurse's coaching on the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse did a really good job of installing an offensive mindset where they're sharing the ball
quotes.quote: Nick Nurse did a really good job of installing an offensive mindset where they're sharing the ball and so you don't have to to think about who gets shots, they're just dedicated to the system and the system is producing the stuff and he was really complimentary of Nick and also the players for buying into it. It takes the players to say we know why you're doing this. He was really complimentary of that. But then he said, you know, I'm watching these fourth quarters and I'm watching Jaylen Brown stand in the fourth in the corner.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Philadelphia 76ers' roster and potential for improvement
quotes.excerpt: they're going to have to do something and they're going to have to do something with that center position
quotes.quote: They're going to have to do something and they're going to have to do something with that center position. This is one thing that is going to become like a, what they end up doing there is going to end up becoming I think an important thing in the East, you know, how, how much can they upgrade there because they're just, you know, like they're, they got a Dem Bona started. And Dem Bona is, you know, he's an energy player. He's not meant to play 25, 30 minutes. And they've been using, you know, they got Jabari Walker who's like 6'7". Uh, they've been plugging him in. He's been, he's been competing, but that's not a solution. One thing I will say, um, Anthony Simons, that was a really good signing. Um, and I think that, you know, he's had, you know, he's played probably six games and I think three of them he's been really good and three of them he hasn't done much. And I think Simons is the type of player that if you don't have to count on every single night and you can just sort of ride him when he's hot, which is the role he has here, you're going to really love him.
